name: Final Rideout
summary:
Final Rideout is about the ride itself.

Hold the handlebars and the bike is yours to manage. Throttle, brakes, clutch and gears all sit in your hands, and the bike answers to how you use them. Lean into a corner, carry too much speed, come up short on a jump: the bike lets you know, and the next run goes better.

Ride through city streets, along a busy interstate and down through a canyon. Every run goes from start to finish against the clock, and your best times wait for you back in the garage.
